from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('outputs/v0/creative-territory-selector.html')
class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=set(); self.buttons=0; self.articles=0; self.scripts=0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in attrs: self.ids.add(attrs['id'])
        if tag=='button': self.buttons+=1
        if tag=='article': self.articles+=1
        if tag=='script': self.scripts+=1
parser=P(); parser.feed(p.read_text())
print({'ids':sorted(parser.ids),'buttons':parser.buttons,'articles':parser.articles,'scripts':parser.scripts,'size':p.stat().st_size})
